description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relation and Sabaragamuwa Development - appointed Mr. S. K. L. Obeysekara and Mr. Albert as the employer's representatives of the Wages Board for the coconut growing trade. This appointment is valid only upto 16.02.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the appointment of two named individuals (Mr. S. K. L. Obeysekara and Mr. Albert Peiris) to specific positions (Employers' Representatives) on the Wages Board for the Coconut Growing Trade. It names the individuals and their basic titles but does not include any detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes with basic titles only.
